hero.title: Flowers that
hero.subtitle: Premium bouquets, thoughtful floral gifts, and trusted local shops for every moment worth remembering.

about.title: Our Story
about.description: We create floral moments with a couture touch, blending velvety blooms, refined palettes, and heartfelt design into every bouquet.
about.valueCraftDesc: Every bouquet is hand-tied by our master florists using time-honored techniques for a truly one-of-a-kind arrangement.
about.valueQualityDesc: We source the freshest seasonal blooms from the world's finest growers, ensuring each petal is flawless.
about.valueHeartDesc: Every arrangement is infused with genuine care and attention, because flowers are more than gifts — they're emotions.
about.valueSpeedDesc: Same-day delivery across the city for orders placed before 5 PM. Your joy, delivered in under an hour.

aboutPage.heroDescription: Muslima Boutique is a modern floral marketplace where local florists, thoughtful gifting, and elegant design meet. We turn everyday moments into memorable gestures with bouquets made to feel personal.
aboutPage.heroQuote: Every bouquet is designed to feel warm, intentional, and beautifully human.
aboutPage.missionTitle: Make flower gifting simple, meaningful, and memorable
aboutPage.missionDescription: We support local florists with a trusted platform, give customers a smoother way to discover bouquets, and keep the entire experience elegant from first click to final delivery.
aboutPage.journeyOneDesc: We hand-pick bouquets, mood, and occasion so customers can choose faster without losing the emotional touch.
aboutPage.journeyTwoDesc: Every flower arrangement is prepared by skilled florists who care about freshness, balance, and presentation.
aboutPage.journeyThreeDesc: We focus on careful handling and timely delivery so the flowers arrive as beautiful as when they left the studio.
aboutPage.storyTitle: From a small idea to a blooming marketplace
aboutPage.storyDescription: Muslima Boutique started with a simple belief: flowers should be easy to send, beautiful to receive, and powerful enough to say what words sometimes cannot.
aboutPage.storyFeatureOne: Handpicked blooms for every occasion and emotion
aboutPage.storyFeatureTwo: Master florists craft each arrangement with care
aboutPage.storyFeatureThree: Personal consultation to bring your vision to life
aboutPage.storyImageAlt: A florist arranging flowers in a warm studio
aboutPage.contactCardDescription: We stay close to our customers and partners, helping each order feel smooth, calm, and cared for.
aboutPage.communityCardDescription: We are proud to grow with local florists and help small floral businesses reach more people.
aboutPage.closingText: Whether you are celebrating, apologizing, encouraging, or simply saying hello, we want every bouquet to feel like a thoughtful message.
aboutPage.heroCardDescription: Every bouquet is designed to feel warm, intentional, and beautifully human.

occasionPage.heroDescription: Every moment matters. Whether it is love, celebration, gratitude, or support, we have the perfect flowers to express it beautifully.
occasionPage.heroImageAlt: A romantic bouquet arranged for special occasions
occasionPage.heroQuote: Thoughtfully styled bouquets for the moments that deserve more than words.
occasionPage.sectionTitle: Find the right bouquet for the feeling you want to share
occasionPage.sectionDescription: Start with the emotion or event. Each collection is designed to feel elegant, intentional, and easy to choose from.
occasionPage.loveRomanceDesc: Express your love with beautiful roses and romantic florals.
occasionPage.birthdayDesc: Make birthdays special with bright and joyful flower arrangements.
occasionPage.congratulationsDesc: Celebrate achievements and new beginnings with elegant blooms.
occasionPage.sympathyDesc: Send comfort and support with our thoughtful sympathy flowers.
occasionPage.thankYouDesc: Show your gratitude with flowers that speak from the heart.
occasionPage.anniversaryDesc: Celebrate your special day with timeless and elegant bouquets.
occasionPage.holidaysDesc: From Christmas to Eid, brighten every holiday with festive flowers.
occasionPage.getWellDesc: Send healing wishes with fresh and cheerful flower arrangements.
occasionPage.customDescription: Tell us the moment, and we'll design a custom bouquet just for you.
occasionPage.customImageAlt: Custom romantic bouquet for special gifting
occasionPage.customCardDescription: A bouquet built around your story, color palette, and occasion.
occasionPage.howDescription: Three simple steps to send the perfect bouquet for any occasion.
occasionPage.howStep1Description: Pick the moment you want to celebrate, from birthdays to anniversaries and everything in between.
occasionPage.howStep2Description: Browse our curated collection of bouquets chosen to match the mood and meaning of your occasion.
occasionPage.howStep3Description: We prepare and deliver your bouquet with care so it arrives fresh and beautifully presented.
occasionPage.customFeatureOne: Personalized color palette and flower selection
occasionPage.customFeatureTwo: Hand-tied by master florists with premium blooms
occasionPage.customFeatureThree: Dedicated consultation to capture your vision
